description: Indicative gold and silver rates in INR derived from international spot prices, with source timestamps
source: api.gold-api.com spot (free, no key) + keraladaily currency/inr snapshot

data.basis: Derived from international spot prices converted at the latest INR snapshot. Indicative only, not a live or retail rate: Indian shop rates are higher (premiums, making charges, GST) and vary by shop and city.
